about_the_game:
Key Features:

  • Normal and Remix modes

  • Simple Controls

  • 15+ Recipes & Variations and 5 Food Stations

  • Replayable Roguelike Gameplay

  • 30+ Unique Roguelike Modifiers

  • Global High Score Leaderboards

GrappleBurger!

In GrappleBurger you take on the role of a robotic chef floating in a kitchen in space! Using the Left and RIght mouse buttons, grab, throw, and cook your recipes to perfection! Control the chaos of your kitchen as swarms of asteroids and customers surround your kitchen. Can you handle the heat of the kitchen or will you drown in the Glorp?

Two Unique Gamemodes!

Choose between the Classic and Remix modes to find a playstyle that fits you! Perfect your scores in the static, level-based Classic mode, or test your skill in the longer, fully-randomized roguelike Remix mode! Will you master the Classic recipes or craft the perfect Remix build?

Cook Many Different Foods!

Master 6 unique recipes with several variations, including your signature purple ingredient: Glorp! Fry, grill, blend, and craft your recipes to perfection, but be quick, robots get hungry faster than you think! 

Global And Friends Only Leaderboards!

See how you stack up to the competition with in-game global leaderboards! Fight for the top scores between each Classic level, and each Remix difficulty. Compete with your friends for the highest score! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or later
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 550/equivalent or higher
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: You can run this game on a potato
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760/equivalent or higher
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: We recommend playing this game on something better than a potato

short_description: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?
